title: asset_metrics.csv
description: Row schema for asset_metrics.csv. Empty cells are NaN under pandas; validators must treat NaN as null. The five *_score columns are retained for CSV alignment only and carry no meaning as of v0.4.0.

subtype.$comment: Present for commercial, community_facility, residential, undeveloped_parcel. Absent (null) for green_space in current B3 output.

accessibility_score.$comment: Deprecated bridge metric. Retained during the Phase 4 transition. New code should read coverage_ratio_*_walk / coverage_ratio_*_drive instead.

effective_demand_by_subtype_json.$comment: Phase B.1 — per-subtype Huff demand, e.g. {"supermarket": 3000.0, "f_and_b": 800.0}.

dsr_by_subtype_json.$comment: Phase B.2 — per-subtype DSR. Each subtype divides its own Huff demand by its own area.

occupancy_by_subtype_calc_json.$comment: Phase B.2 — per-subtype occupancy computed by B3. Preferred over the observed occupancy_by_subtype_json when both are present.

energy_by_subtype_json.$comment: Phase B.2 — per-subtype raw energy (kWh) before breakdown. Scale factor converts lettable area to floor area.

carbon_by_subtype_json.$comment: Phase B.2 — per-subtype operational carbon (tCO2e). Sum equals carbon_operational_tco2e.

occupancy_trend_3yr.$comment: Phase B.1 — linear slope of occupancy over the last 3 years. Negative = declining.

noi_trend_3yr.$comment: Phase B.1 — linear slope of NOI over the last 3 years. Negative = worsening.

peak_occupancy.$comment: Phase B.1 — historical peak occupancy in the 5-year window.

years_since_peak.$comment: Phase B.1 — years elapsed since the peak occupancy was recorded.

vacancy_streak_months.$comment: Phase B.1 — latest vacancy_duration_months in the observed series.

trajectory_class.$comment: Phase B.1 — coarse trajectory classification from the 5-year history.

energy_kwh_lighting_equipment.$comment: Phase 11 — lighting and tenant equipment energy.

carbon_productive_tco2e.$comment: Phase 11 — operational carbon proportional to occupancy/utilisation.

carbon_stranded_tco2e.$comment: Phase 11 — operational carbon wasted on unused capacity.

embodied_carbon_total_tco2e.$comment: Phase 11 — life-cycle carbon locked into the structure.

embodied_carbon_amortised_tco2e.$comment: Phase 11 — annual amortised share of embodied carbon.

maintenance_carbon_tco2e.$comment: Phase 11 — annual carbon from maintenance activities.

t_asset_c.$comment: Observed mean Landsat 8 Level-2 surface temperature in the asset footprint, degrees Celsius.

t_township_c.$comment: Observed township baseline: mean temperature across the union of asset parcel footprints, degrees Celsius.

surface_temp_delta_c.$comment: Observed Tasset - Ttownship in degrees Celsius. Positive = warmer than the asset-footprint township baseline; negative = cooler.

surface_temp_provenance.$comment: Field-level provenance label; populated as Observed (Landsat 8 L2) only when an asset LST is available.

financial_score.$comment: Removed in v0.4.0. Kept for CSV column alignment. Do not consume.
